chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"The Mufrid (one who performs Hajj independently) is required to perform Tawaf around the House, two Rak'at at the Station of Ibrahim (peace be upon him), Sa'i between Safa and Marwah, and the Tawaf of Ziyarah (visitation), which is the Tawaf of the Women. There is no Hady (sacrificial animal) or Udhiyah (specific sacrifice) upon him."

I asked him about the Mufrid for Hajj, does he perform Tawaf around the House after the obligatory Tawaf? He said: 'Yes, as much as he wishes, and he renews the Talbiyah after the two Rak'at. And the Qarin (one who combines Hajj and Umrah) at that station, both of them bind what is permissible of the Tawaf with the Talbiyah.'

Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: The jurisprudence (Fiqh) of this Hadith is that it has been permitted for the Qarin and the Mufrid to advance the Tawaf of Ziyarah before standing at the two stations (Arafat and Muzdalifah). Whenever they do this, if they do not renew the Talbiyah, they become Muhrimayn (in a state of Ihram with a defect), and that is not permissible. Therefore, for this reason, the Mufrid and the Sa'iq (one who brings the Hady) were ordered to renew the Talbiyah at the time of Tawaf, even though the Sa'iq does not become fully free (from the Hady obligation) even if he has performed Tawaf for the sake of his Hady. This was narrated.

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: Al-Talbiyah: The recitation of 'Labbayk Allahumma Hajj' which signifies the state of Ihram.
key_terms.السَّائِقُ: Al-Sa'iq: One who brings their sacrificial animal (Hady) with them.
key_terms.الْقَارِنُ: Al-Qarin: One who performs Hajj al-Qiran, combining Umrah and Hajj in one Ihram.
key_terms.الْمُفْرِدُ: Mufrid: One who performs Hajj al-Mufrid, entering Ihram for Hajj alone without Umrah.
key_terms.طَوَافُ الزِّيَارَةِ: Tawaf al-Ziyarah: The Tawaf of Visitation, performed after arriving at Mecca.
key_terms.مُحِلَّيْنِ: Muhrimayn: Two people in a state of Ihram, often implying a specific ritual status or defect in this context.

ai.seo_question: What are the ritual requirements for the Mufrid regarding Tawaf and Talbiyah renewal before standing at Arafat?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the ritual flexibility for the Mufrid and Qarin, permitting the performance of Tawaf al-Ziyarah before the standing at Arafat. It emphasizes the critical scholarly distinction that renewing the Talbiyah after the initial rites is essential to maintain the state of Ihram, whereas failing to do so results in exiting the sacred state, a nuance particularly relevant for the Qarin who combines Hajj and Umrah.
